parsed.name: EIGER X射线探测器
parsed.description: EIGER 是一种混合像素光子计数型 X 射线面阵探测器，用于在同步辐射和实验室 X 射线实验中采集衍射或散射图像。
parsed.description_en: The EIGER is a hybrid-pixel photon-counting X-ray area detector used to acquire diffraction or scattering images in synchrotron and laboratory X-ray experiments.
